equipment.name: Breacher charges
equipment.desc: A model in base contact with a Fortification or a building may give up its melee attacks during its activation to automatically inflict one hit with Strength 10, AP-4 on it.

equipment.name: Vigil storm shield
equipment.desc: The model gains a 3+ ward save. The ward save of a Vigil storm shield does not stack with other ward saves. The model may not gain an additional attack for carrying two close combat weapons.
